summary: Frontend-only verification after supervisor/Vite launcher infra fix. Preview URL returns HTTP 200; homepage hero 'Put the Kingdom Before the Company.' renders. All 8 requested routes (/, /book, /workbook, /decision-test, /about, /faq, /resources, /contact) render real content via direct URL load (SPA fallback works) with h1s present and no blank screens. In-app nav link clicks (client-side routing) work for Assessment/The Book/Workbook/About/Home. Key images /workbook-cover.webp (800x1000) and /book-3d-cover.webp (669x1100) load and are visible; direct asset GETs return 200. Zero console errors, zero pageerrors, zero HTTP >=400 responses observed. Mobile (390x844) home renders with no horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: backend program is FATAL ('Exited too quickly'). Not required for this static Vite site (/api/* are Vercel serverless in prod), but worth silencing/removing from supervisor to avoid confusion.

action_items: Optional: remove/disable the FATAL 'backend' supervisor program since this project has no local FastAPI backend.
critical_code_review_comments: Interactive elements lack data-testid attributes; tests had to rely on roles/text. Add data-testid to nav links, CTA buttons and form inputs for stable automation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview is up and rendering. Vite launcher at /app/frontend/package.json works; supervisor frontend RUNNING. Not tested: /api/subscribe email submission (mocked/unavailable in preview, out of scope), /privacy, /terms, /disclaimer, /payment/* routes, and the decision-test full question flow.
rca_of_the_issue: Original outage: supervisor frontend program expected /app/frontend but the Vite app lives at /app root, so the service went FATAL. Fix (launcher package.json in /app/frontend that cd's to /app and runs vite on 0.0.0.0:3000) is verified working.
